messages:
deploy-bot: Preflight check for 'hawthorn' private rollout scheduled 2026-04-02 02:00UTC. CI: pass, infra: pass, smoke-tests: pending. See /deploy/1932101111
jen: scheduling note — customer wants 02:00 UTC window, they requested minimal traffic impact. can we keep canary under 5%?
mike: we can do 3% canary for 30m, then 25% for 20m, then 100% if no regressions. rollback window 30m after canary start.
sara: product asks for version pin: model v2.3.1-quant, runtime image rwinf-4.12. Need note in release: "pin to v2.3.1-quant for latency improvements".
elaine: cs update — hawthorn ops blackout from 01:30-03:00 UTC on maintenance day, they still OK with 02:00 start. they want a heads-up 1h before cutover. @nate-cs to confirm comms cadence.
nate-cs: confirmed, will email customer 24h and ping 1h before. also collecting list of contact names for hotfix approvals.
mike: alerting/SLIs: latency p50 < 120ms, p95 < 600ms; error rate < 0.5%. If breached during canary, auto-rollback. ops-bot: created pager runbook link /runbooks/hawthorn-cutover.
jen: ops checklist snippet:
```
- pin deployment to image: rwinf-4.12
- model: v2.3.1-quant (no auto-promote)
- canary: 3% -> 25% -> 100%
- monitoring: perf + quality evals running
- fallback: route to hosted-v1 if rollback
```
mike: suggest adding an eval prompt-set to monitor hallucination rate during canary, threshold 1.5% false-positive on key intents.
sara: added note to release notes: "Quality gating: prompt-set 'hawthorn-core-20' will be evaluated during canary; any regression triggers rollback."
elaine: legal asked about logs retention for private deployment — confirmed same retention as Dedicated (90d) per contract.
jen: final approvals? pls respond with :thumbsup: or :thumbsdown:. tagging approvers: @mike @sara @elaine @nate-cs
mike: :thumbsup: (will watch alerts)
sara: :thumbsup:
elaine: :thumbsup: will send comms after deploy-bot schedules reminder
deploy-bot: Scheduling automated rollout: 2026-04-02T02:00:00Z. Canary plan set. Patch job id: 59321.
ops-bot: Runbook link posted and pager escalation set to oncall-sre.
jen: executing final rollout command at T-1h: `rw deploy start --customer hawthorn --image rwinf-4.12 --model v2.3.1-quant --canary 3,25 --auto-rollback-on-alert`
mike: monitoring hooks in place, teams on standby.
nate-cs: I'll be oncall for customer contact. thanks team — good luck.
